subject: [hw] DONE V40 rev 3: F14 fixed (mmap offset wrap + 64-bit iova truncation), 1176/1176
body:
DONE V40 rev 3: R1 finding F14 (low) fixed. No interface change.

F14 was correct: vcu_mmap_ioctl() computed `end = offset + len` before the MAP_SHMEM_* range tests, so a 64-bit mmap offset near UINT64_MAX wrapped and could pass them (guest-memory aliasing only, no host escape). Fix:
 - any offset above VCU_MMAP_OFFSET_MAX = 0x900000000 (above MAP_SHMEM_PA_BASE + 4 GiB, i.e. above every base the model resolves) is rejected before the addition, so `end` cannot wrap;
 - the MM_BASE / MM_CACHEABLE_BASE / PA_BASE paths now go through vcu_mmap_clean_iova(), which rejects an iova above 32 bits instead of truncating it onto another buffer.
Five checks added: offset 0xfffffffffffff000 and UINT64_MAX -> 0/EINVAL, iova 0x100000000 -> 0, and a positive MAP_SHMEM_PA_BASE + pa mapping through n2vc_dma_lookup_pa.

    bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh
    == V40 build/run: asan   SUMMARY 392 392
    == V40 build/run: o2     SUMMARY 392 392
    == V40 build/run: tsan   SUMMARY 392 392
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1176/1176
(three builds of 392 checks: ASan+UBSan -O1, -O2, TSan -O1; about 5 s; /tmp/n2hw-V40 only.)
    bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (compile only)

STATUS updated (gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/STATUS.md section "Review findings", dsh-state/workers/V40/STATUS.md). Everything else in DONE V40 rev 2 stands, including the not-done/deviations list. Please re-check F14 and send anything else; I stay available.
